question.text: How many world records will be set at the 2026 World Aquatics Swimming Championships?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as number of new world records set at the [2026 World Aquatics Swimming Championships (25m)](https://www.worldaquatics.com/competitions/5052/world-aquatics-swimming-championships-25m-2026).
question.fine_print: The primary source for this question will be [OmegaTiming](https://www.omegatiming.com/2026/world-aquatics-swimming-championships-25m-live-results). Other credible sources may also be used.

research:
## Research brief: world records at the 2026 Short Course Worlds (Beijing, 1-6 December 2026)

**Summary:** The meet has not started, so no records have been set yet. The last two editions produced 14 (2022) and 30 (2024). Records have been falling fast this autumn: at least 9 new short course world records plus 2 ties since early October. Summer McIntosh will not be in Beijing.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-13: The OmegaTiming results page shows only "1-6 December 2026, Beijing" and "no additional information at the moment". It has no results or records yet. [OmegaTiming](https://www.omegatiming.com/2026/world-aquatics-swimming-championships-25m-live-results)
- It is unclear whether a tied world record counts as a "new world record". Ties happen at this level (see section 3), so this could change the count.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled. Competition starts 2026-12-01.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-13: Russia named 43 swimmers for Beijing, including Egor Kornev and Kliment Kolesnikov. [RIA](https://ria.ru/20261113/plavanie-2131453827.html)
- 2026-11-13: Luca Hoek set a Spanish 100 free record of 45.93 at a qualifying meet in Madrid. [Mundo Deportivo](https://www.mundodeportivo.com/natacion/20261113/1004250768/asi-equipo-espanol-mundial-pekin-us-open-segunda-jornada-open-madrid.html)
- 2026-11-04: World Aquatics said the U.S. trials (Westmont, Illinois, 28-31 October) produced six world records: five new and one tied. [World Aquatics](https://www.worldaquatics.com/news/4604223/six-world-records-highlight-2026-us-short-course-trials-as-douglass-alexy-curzan-berkoff-and-mathias-make-history)
  - New: Kate Douglass 100 free (49.64), Katharine Berkoff 50 back (25.21), Van Mathias 100 breast (55.14), Jack Alexy 100 free (44.64), Claire Curzan 100 back (53.92)
  - Tied: Douglass 50 free (22.75)
  - The U.S. team for Beijing has 38 athletes, including all of these swimmers and Gretchen Walsh.
- October 2026: Walsh lowered the 50 free world record to 22.75 (no exact date found). [NBC Sports](https://www.nbcsports.com/olympics/news/gretchen-walsh-world-record-50-freestyle-short-course-meters)
- 2026-10-13: Swimming World listed the World Cup world records:
  - 10-02: Kornev tied the 100 free record (44.84)
  - 10-09: Pieter Coetze, 50 back (22.09)
  - 10-10: Kornev, 50 fly (21.28)
  - 10-11: Tomoyuki Matsushita, 400 IM (3:54.33)
  
  [Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/world-record-recap-17-global-standards-have-been-set-this-year-how-many-more-will-fall-full-list/)
- What this means for Beijing: many 2026 records are fresh and held by swimmers who will be there (Walsh, Douglass, Curzan, Berkoff, Alexy, Mathias, Kornev, Coetze, Matsushita). Fresh records raise the bar for beating them again, but these swimmers are clearly in record form.
- Roster news:
  - Summer McIntosh is not on Canada's team. She set several 2024 records (400 free, 200 fly, 400 IM). [SwimSwam](https://swimswam.com/canada-announces-summer-mcintosh-less-roster-for-2026-short-course-world-championships/)
  - Leon Marchand will race for France in his first short course Worlds. [Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/leon-marchand-headlines-18-strong-france-team-for-world-short-course-championships/)
  - World Aquatics granted 34 wildcard entries, the first time it has run a wildcard program. [Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/world-aquatics-announces-34-wildcard-athletes-for-world-short-course-championships/)
- Walsh's form at the U.S. trials was mixed: 53.50 in the 100 fly and 56.58 in the 100 IM, well off her 55.11 record. [Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/u-s-short-course-trials-day-two-womens-finals-gretchen-walsh-regan-smith-secure-beijing-spots-as-world-records-fall/)

### 4. Base rates
| Edition | World records | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 2024 Budapest | 30 (the event's record total; women 20, men 10; Walsh about 10-11) | [SwimSwam](https://swimswam.com/all-30-world-records-broken-at-short-course-worlds/), [Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/world-record-reflections-a-glance-back-at-all-30-set-in-budapest-at-short-course-worlds) |
| 2022 Melbourne | 14 | [SwimSwam](https://swimswam.com/?p=887698) |
| 2021 Abu Dhabi | 4 or fewer | [SwimSwam](https://swimswam.com/?p=885424) |
| 2018 Hangzhou | Total not found; reports mention U.S. mixed relay records | [CBC](https://amp.cbc.ca/sports/olympics/summer/aquatics/united-states-world-record-freestyle-1.4942480) |
| 2014 Doha | 23 (the record before 2024) | [SwimSwam](https://swimswam.com/?p=885424) |

- The counts swing a lot from one edition to the next, from 4 or fewer up to 30.
- The two most recent editions (2022 and 2024, both in December) were high.
- The 2026 autumn pace, about 11 record-or-tie swims in roughly 4 weeks, looks closer to the run-up to 2024 than to 2021.
- There is no seasonal pattern to compare: the meet is a single event every two years, always held in December.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has a market "Short Course Worlds 2026: World Records Broken?" covering four events: men's 100 free, men's 50 free, women's 100 fly and women's 100 back. All show 0.50/0.50 placeholder prices, which suggests no real trading, so they tell us little.
- The Polymarket winner markets show identical placeholder prices (0.485) for every swimmer, so they are uninformative too.
- The Kalshi markets in the data are about athletics, not swimming, so they don't apply.
- I found no market on the total number of records and no expert forecast of the total.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Other national short course meets are still serving as qualifiers this month, such as the German championships (Wuppertal, from 12 November) and the Spanish meet in Madrid. A record set at one of these would raise the bar in that event.
- Beijing, 1-6 December: watch for final entry lists and scratches (whether Walsh, Douglass and Marchand swim their full programs) and the daily record count on OmegaTiming.
- Weather is not relevant: the meet is indoors.

**Sources:** [OmegaTiming](https://www.omegatiming.com/2026/world-aquatics-swimming-championships-25m-live-results), [World Aquatics](https://www.worldaquatics.com/news/4604223/six-world-records-highlight-2026-us-short-course-trials-as-douglass-alexy-curzan-berkoff-and-mathias-make-history), [Swimming World recap](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/world-record-recap-17-global-standards-have-been-set-this-year-how-many-more-will-fall-full-list/), [Swimming World U.S. trials](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/u-s-short-course-trials-day-two-womens-finals-gretchen-walsh-regan-smith-secure-beijing-spots-as-world-records-fall/), [SwimSwam 30 records](https://swimswam.com/all-30-world-records-broken-at-short-course-worlds/), [SwimSwam history](https://swimswam.com/?p=885424), [SwimSwam Canada](https://swimswam.com/canada-announces-summer-mcintosh-less-roster-for-2026-short-course-world-championships/), [Swimming World France](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news/leon-marchand-headlines-18-strong-france-team-for-world-short-course-championships/), [NBC Sports](https://www.nbcsports.com/olympics/news/gretchen-walsh-world-record-50-freestyle-short-course-meters), [RIA](https://ria.ru/20261113/plavanie-2131453827.html)

## 4. Base rates (world records per edition of this meet)
- 2024 Budapest: 30, including 6 in relays. Walsh alone set 11, and Noè Ponti and McIntosh set 3 each. [World Aquatics](https://www.worldaquatics.com/news/4186271/record-setting-world-aquatics-swimming-championships-25m-in-budapest-caps-an-incredible-year-of-aquatics)

[USA Swimming](https://www.usaswimming.org/news/2018/12/16/team-usa-wraps-dominant-fina-world-championships-(25m)-with-nine-medal-performance)
- The trend is sharply up since 2021 (roughly 4, 14, 30). The swing between editions is large, around ±10 or more. Relays, including the 4x50 events, typically supply many of the records.
- The 2026 pre-meet season has been unusually fast: at least 11 short course world records in October, including the 50 free tie.
- The seasonal calendar adjustment doesn't apply: this is a single meet held every two years.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket "Short Course Worlds 2026: World Records Broken?" covers four events: men's 100 free, men's 50 free, women's 100 fly and women's 100 back. All sit at a placeholder 0.50 Yes, which looks like an unpriced or illiquid market. Related winner markets are also flat at about 0.485. None of these gives a total count.
- The Kalshi markets supplied are for athletics records and don't match this question.
- I found no Manifold, Metaculus or expert forecast of the total.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-12-01 to 06: The championships themselves, with heats and finals daily. Records can fall in heats, semis, finals and relay lead-off legs, each of which counts.
- Late November: final entry lists may surface more withdrawals or additions. Walsh's event program and Marchand's entries are the main ones to watch.
- Mid-November: national short course meets in Germany, Spain and elsewhere are still under way and could lower records again before Beijing.
- Weather is not relevant: the meet is indoors.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 3 weeks remain. The meet runs 1-6 December 2026 in Beijing, and the final count should be known by about 7 December.

(b) The resolution source (OmegaTiming, checked 2026-11-13) shows 0 records. The competition has not started.

(c) If nothing changed, the count would be 0. That outcome is not meaningful, because the meet will happen and will almost certainly produce some records.

(d) The current trend points high. At least 9 new short course world records plus 2 ties were set this autumn, mostly by swimmers going to Beijing (Douglass, Curzan, Berkoff, Alexy, Mathias, Kornev, Coetze, Matsushita, Walsh). Relays, especially the mixed 4x50s and the U.S. relays, are frequent sources of records. Leon Marchand's short course Worlds debut adds IM and breaststroke chances. Two things pull the other way:
- Many records are only weeks old, which raises the bar.
- Summer McIntosh, a source of several 2024 records, is absent.
- Walsh, who set about 10 of the 30 records in 2024, looked off form at the U.S. trials.

(e) Past totals varied widely:

| Edition | World records |
|---|---|
| 2014 | 23 |
| 2018 | roughly 5-10 |
| 2021 | 4 or fewer |
| 2022 | 14 |
| 2024 | 30 |

The spread runs from about 3 to 30.

(f) There is no expert or market forecast of the total. The Polymarket per-event markets show 0.50 placeholder prices and carry no information. The question creator's range of 2 to 30 matches the historical spread.

(g) Low scenario: the U.S. swimmers peaked at their October trials, Walsh stays off form, the relays fall short of records, and the meet produces only 3-5 records.
High scenario: the Americans and Marchand peak in Beijing, Walsh rebounds to her 2024 form, the relays sweep, and the total reaches 30 or more.

Unclear tie handling could also shift the count by 1-2.

My median is about 14, roughly matching 2022 and somewhat below 2024 given McIntosh's absence and Walsh's form, with a right skew toward a 2024-style outcome.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** The autumn of 2026 has been a strong record season. There have been about 11 world records or ties since early October. Many of them came from swimmers who will race in Beijing, including:
- Walsh, Douglass, Curzan, Berkoff, Alexy and Mathias for the U.S.
- Kornev for Russia, Coetze for South Africa, Matsushita for Japan.

Marchand will swim his first short course Worlds, and the Russians are back. Relays and mixed relays add many chances for records, as in 2024. This looks closer to the 2022 to 2024 environment than to 2021. Pointing against a repeat of 2024: McIntosh is absent, and many records were set only weeks ago, so the bar is higher. My central estimate is about 14 to 16.

(e) **Historical variation:** Totals by edition:
- 2021: about 4

- 2024: 30

The spread is very wide, so the uncertainty is large.

(f) **Experts and markets:** The Polymarket markets show placeholder prices of 0.50 and carry no information. I found no expert forecast of the total.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- *Low:* A slow pool, or a key swimmer such as Walsh scratching or missing her taper. Swimmers could also peak at their October trials and fail to match those times. Together this could leave roughly 3 to 5 records, mostly relays.
- *High:* Walsh and Douglass each set several individual records, and the U.S. relays sweep their events. Marchand breaks the IM records and Kornev and Kolesnikov hit the sprint marks. If tied records also count, the total could reach 35 or more.
